subject: Discovery follow-up: Redwood demo & security deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@finpath.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up & next steps

Hi Alex / Sam —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost on financial document processing while keeping latency under 200ms for critical paths.
- Current constraints: on-prem data residency for PII, SOC 2 compliance requirements, procurement window in Q4.
- Success criteria: 30% unit cost reduction, stable <200ms p95, and SOC2 evidence for audit.

Suggested next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (security + platform) — 60–90 minutes
2) Procurement / contract discussion — 30 minutes (can be separate)
3) Trial access (Dedicated or Private) for a 30-day pilot

Are you available for a technical deep dive next week? I can propose:
- Tue 2026-09-07 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 2026-09-08 09:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 2026-09-09 13:00–14:30 PT

I’ll loop in our Platform and Security leads so we can cover architecture and SOC2 artifacts. Attached: redwood-product-overview.pdf and a SOC2 evidence checklist so you can see what we typically provide.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Attachment: redwood-product-overview.pdf (summary deck, 6 slides)

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap — that captures things well. We’re interested in the technical deep dive; please include our security lead Priya Kumar (priya.kumar@finpath.com).

Of the times you proposed, Tue 9/7 at 10:00 PT works for me. Priya is out this week but will be back Monday; I’ll confirm with her asap. If Priya can’t make Tue morning, could we do Wed 9/8 09:00 PT as backup?

Also, a quick question on evidence: can you share a sample SOC2 scope and the kinds of logs/audit trails you expose for Dedicated vs Private deployments? Priya will want that ahead of the call.

Thanks,

Subject: Looping in Security & Platform for technical deep dive — Tue 9/7 10:00 PT (proposed)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks, Alex — copying Priya. Priya, hi — nice to e-meet you. I’ve looped in Michael (Security), Rishi (Platform), and Monica (Customer Success) to join the technical deep dive. Quick notes on what we’ll cover so you can pull any artifacts ahead of time:

Agenda (60–90m):
- High-level architecture and options: Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private (20m)
- Data flow & residency controls (KV cache, logging, encryption-at-rest/in-transit) (15m)
- SOC2 artifacts & evidence types (what we can share for Dedicated/Private) (15m)
- Integration plan & pilot scope (metrics, SLAs, timelines) (10m)
- Q&A and next steps (10–20m)

Attachments: soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (this is a checklist of typical artifacts we provide for audits).

Michael — can you confirm what evidence we can share in advance (sample scope, logs, retention settings) and whether we need an NDA or protected link?

Proposed confirmed time: Tue 2026-09-07 10:00–11:30 PT — please reply with thumbs up or propose an alternate. I’ll send a calendar invite with a protective share link for the SOC2 checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi all —

Thanks for the invite, Marissa. Tue 9/7 10:00 PT works for me and I appreciate the checklist — that helps. A couple of quick asks for the meeting so we can come prepared:
1) If you can share a redacted sample SOC2 scope and a sample of the audit log schema (fields + retention) that would be great.
2) On the deployment option: we are leaning to Private (on-prem) but want to understand the trade-offs for Dedicated vs Private for latency and evidence access.
3) For procurement: please include an initial ballpark for pilot pricing and a list of procurement contacts/steps — we’ll have our procurement lead loop in after the tech call.

Alex — I’ll have our procurement lead (name to follow) on the procurement thread after the tech call.

See you Tuesday,
Priya Kumar
Head of Security | FinPath
